title: TreeWidzard: An Engine for Width-Based Dynamic Programming and Automated Theorem Proving
summary: In this work, we introduce TreeWidzard, an engine for developing dynamic programming algorithms that decide graph-theoretic properties parameterized by treewidth and pathwidth. Besides providing a unified framework for algorithms deciding atomic graph-theoretic properties, our engine allows one to combine such algorithms for two purposes: to obtain dynamic programming algorithms for more complex graph properties, and to support treewidth-based automated theorem proving.
